title: The new De Rosa 838 bike, in the view of Cristiano De Rosa

takeaways.text: De Rosa positions the 838 as 'your first De Rosa' rather than entry level, with a carbon frame claimed at 900 g, a slightly sloping top tube and an elliptical bottom-bracket area for stiffness.
The head tube integrates all cable routing for a clean front end; minimal rear stays.

disclosure: Cristiano De Rosa presents his company's bike on a marketplace channel; all statements are manufacturer claims.
summary: A two-minute presentation of the New 838 by Cristiano De Rosa, in Italian.
